title: 第3827章 交朋友第3826章 苏长歌被嫌弃了
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 叶璇璇也哄道：“徒弟能给我们当贴身侍卫那是我们的荣幸，我们高兴还来不及，怎么能够不欢迎呢？她们几个是跟你开玩笑的，你莫要当真啊。”
叶清瑶也附和道，“没错，有苏哥哥在身边，我们才能安心。”
听到这话，苏长歌的脸色这才缓和了一些，高傲的道：“看见你们求我的份上，那我就勉为其难答应了。”
“我事先声明，保护你们，但我可不是你们的侍卫，你们逛你们的，我会离得远远的，不会打扰你们。”
叶清瑶笑着答应道：“苏哥哥才不是什么侍卫，哪有侍卫长得这么帅，修为这么高的，这分明就是我们的护花使者。”
“没错，能苏前辈被保护是我们的荣幸。”紫月也附和道。
她们你一言我一语，很快就把苏长歌哄好了。
随后，苏长歌带着叶璇璇一行人出了宗门。
她们来到了最热闹，最繁华的城池。
当她们出现在城池的时候，所有人的目光顿时都被吸引住了。
“卧槽，这些女子个个倾国倾城，美若天仙，就好像不食人间烟火的仙女一般！”
“这也太漂亮了吧，比我之前见到过最美丽的花魁还要美上百倍不止！”
“那些花魁算什么？根本就没办法这些相提并论，简直就是一文不值，跟她们提鞋都不配！”
“这些国色天香的女子出现，其他人都显得黯然失色，她们绝对是我见过最美丽的女人！”
这些人都惊艳她们的美貌，但没有一个人出来找不痛快。
紫月忍不住吐槽道：“我就说苏前辈太小心了吧，根本没人敢找我们的麻烦。”
不过没人找麻烦正好，她不想被一些无关紧要的人破坏了心情。
“紫月，你快别说话了，被苏前辈听到该不该高兴了。”明月在一旁小声提醒道。
“好知道了。”紫月无所谓的道。
这一路她们走到哪玩到哪，别人的目光都跟到哪，就像个狗皮膏一样，甩都甩不掉，不过她们也无可奈何，时间久了也就习以为常了。
除了这一点，她们玩的非常开心，非常尽兴。
但他们不知道的是，在当她们刚出现的时候，就有几双眼睛一直盯着她们，从未离开，只不过在这热闹繁华的地方被掩饰的很好。
这样简单而又幸福的时光一晃而逝，玩到了傍晚，她们便准备离开。
出了城池以后，苏长歌神念一动，半空中立刻出现一艘豪华的飞舟。
苏长歌淡淡一笑，道：“玩了一天，你们也都累了，我们坐飞舟回去。”
“好啊。”
“苏哥哥想的真周到。”
“苏前辈太贴心了！”
她们当然没有意见。
她们坐上飞舟，准备离开的时候，突然感知到一股陌生的气息，而后就看到一群人出现在面前，挡住了去路。
为首的是一名身穿华丽锦袍的年轻人，身边有四名穿着一模一样的黑袍中年男子。
这四人不仅穿着一样，而且修为也都在同一个级别，都是大帝之资，不过层次略微有些不同，有的是三重，有的是五重，有的是七重，最高的也过去巅峰期而已。
叶璇璇皱了皱秀眉，直接道：“你们拦住我们的去路，想干什么？”
锦袍男子笑了笑，率先说道：“各位姑娘，别紧张，我事先声明，我对你们没有恶意，只是想跟各位美丽的姑娘交个朋友。”
“那真是不凑巧了，我们不想跟你交朋友，麻烦让开。”叶璇璇毫不客气的拒绝道。
她的直觉告诉她，这人不像是什么好人。
但是锦袍男子好像没听到她的话一般，一动不动，没有丝毫让步的意思。
见状，紫月冷哼一声，不满的道：“你是聋了吗？没听到吗，还不赶紧让开。”
被冷眼相待，锦袍男子不怒反笑，道：“几位姑娘，火气别这么大，只要你们愿意跟我交朋友，你们说什么我都照做。”
他的言外之意就是不跟他交朋友，那么就休想离开。
明月开口道：“你为什么想跟我们交朋友？我若没猜错的话，是看上了我们的外表，对吧？”

content_en:
Ye Xuanxuan also coaxed: "It's our honor for our apprentice to be our personal bodyguard. It's too late for us to be happy, so how can we not welcome him? They are joking with you, don't take it seriously."
Ye Qingyao also echoed, "Yes, only with Brother Su by our side can we feel at ease."
After hearing this, Su Changge's expression softened a little, and he said arrogantly: "Seeing you begging for my sake, I reluctantly agreed."
"I declare in advance that I will protect you, but I am not your bodyguard. If you go to your place, I will stay far away and will not disturb you."
Ye Qingyao smiled and agreed: "Brother Su is not a guard. How can any guard be so handsome and have such a high level of cultivation? He is clearly our flower protector."
"Yes, it is our honor to be able to protect Senior Su." Ziyue also agreed.
They talked to each other and quickly coaxed Su Changge into peace.
Afterwards, Su Changge took Ye Xuanxuan and his party out of the sect.
They came to the busiest and most prosperous city.
When they appeared in the city, everyone's eyes were immediately attracted.
"Damn it, these women are all stunning in their beauty. They are as beautiful as celestial beings. They are like fairies who do not eat the fireworks of this world!"
"This is so beautiful, a hundred times more beautiful than the most beautiful courtesan I have ever seen before!"
"Who are those oirans? There is no way to compare them. They are simply worthless. They are not even worthy of carrying shoes!"
"The appearance of these beautiful and fragrant women makes everyone else look eclipsed. They are definitely the most beautiful women I have ever seen!"
…………
These people were all amazed by their beauty, but no one was unhappy when they came out to find them.
Ziyue couldn't help complaining: "I would say that Senior Su is too careful. No one dares to cause trouble for us."
But it was good that no one was looking for trouble, and she didn't want her mood to be ruined by some irrelevant people.
"Ziyue, please stop talking. You should be happy to be heard by Senior Su." Mingyue reminded in a low voice from the side.
"I understand." Zi Yue said indifferently.
Wherever they went and played, other people's eyes followed them everywhere. It was like a piece of shit that they couldn't shake off, but there was nothing they could do about it. Over time, they got used to it.
Other than that, they had a great time.
But what they didn't know was that when they first appeared, there were a few pairs of eyes staring at them and never leaving, but they were well concealed in this lively and prosperous place.
Such a simple and happy time passed by in a flash, and by the evening, they were ready to leave.
After leaving the city, Su Changge had a mental thought, and a luxurious flying boat immediately appeared in mid-air.
Su Changge smiled lightly and said, "You are all tired after playing for a day. Let's go back by flying boat."
"Okay."
"Brother Su is so thoughtful."
"Senior Su is so considerate!"
Of course they have no objection.
They got on the flying boat and were about to leave when they suddenly felt a strange smell, and then saw a group of people appearing in front of them, blocking the way.
The leader was a young man wearing a gorgeous brocade robe, and he was surrounded by four middle-aged men wearing identical black robes.
Not only do these four people wear the same clothes, but their cultivation levels are also at the same level. They are all qualified as great emperors, but their levels are slightly different. Some are at the third level, some are at the fifth level, and some are at the seventh level. The highest ones are just past their peak stage.
Ye Xuanxuan frowned and said directly: "What do you want to do by blocking our way?"
The man in brocade robes smiled and said first: "Girls, don't be nervous. Let me declare in advance that I have no ill intentions towards you. I just want to make friends with all of you beautiful girls."
"That's really unlucky. We don't want to be friends with you, so please get out of the way." Ye Xuanxuan refused unceremoniously.
Her instinct told her that this person didn't look like a good person.
But the man in the brocade robe seemed not to have heard her words. He remained motionless and showed no intention of giving in.
Seeing this, Ziyue snorted coldly and said dissatisfied: "Are you deaf? Didn't you hear? Why don't you get out of the way quickly?"
Being treated coldly, the man in brocade robes smiled instead of being angry and said: "Girls, don't be so angry. As long as you are willing to make friends with me, I will do whatever you say."
The implication of his words is that if you don't make friends with him, then you can never leave.
Mingyue said: "Why do you want to make friends with us? If I guess correctly, you are attracted by our appearance, right?"
